related.title: 光子 tensor core：插入損耗與訊號預算
related.titleEn: Photonic tensor cores: insertion loss and signal budgets
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：事件數守恆或丟失可追蹤，扇出未隱藏，平均和峰值分別有證據。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Events are conserved or losses traced, fanout is explicit, and mean/peak claims have evidence.
related.difference: 把光學核心、光源與電子讀出分開，建立含損耗的功率預算。
related.differenceEn: Separate optical core, source and electronic readout, and build a loss-inclusive power budget.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 單播事件流量=Nrb，N神經元、r事件/s、b bytes/event；多播與路由複製需另計。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 10000個教學神經元，每個20事件/s，每訊息8 bytes，暫不計扇出複製。 流量=10000×20×8/1e6=1.6 MB/s，採十進位MB。
功率透射率T=10^(−L/10)，L以dB表示；電功耗不能直接等同輸出光功率。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 教學入射光功率10 mW，總插入損耗6 dB，先忽略波長差異。 輸出=10×10^(−6/10)=2.511886 mW；此值未包含偵測器雜訊或轉換效率。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Unicast event traffic=Nrb; multicast and routed replication require separate accounting. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. 10000 teaching neurons, 20 events/s each, 8 bytes/event, initially excluding fanout replication. Traffic=10000×20×8/1e6=1.6 decimal MB/s.

Power transmission T=10^(−L/10) for loss L in dB; electrical power is not output optical power. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. Teaching optical input10 mW, total insertion loss6 dB, initially ignoring wavelength dependence. Output=10×10^(−6/10)=2.511886 mW, excluding detector noise and conversion efficiency.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: vLLM KV cache：長上下文容量推導
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：事件數守恆或丟失可追蹤，扇出未隱藏，平均和峰值分別有證據。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Events are conserved or losses traced, fanout is explicit, and mean/peak claims have evidence.
related.difference: 將層數、KV頭數、頭維度、token數及位元組數逐項核算。
related.differenceEn: Account for layers, KV heads, head width, tokens and bytes per value individually.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 單播事件流量=Nrb，N神經元、r事件/s、b bytes/event；多播與路由複製需另計。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 10000個教學神經元，每個20事件/s，每訊息8 bytes，暫不計扇出複製。 流量=10000×20×8/1e6=1.6 MB/s，採十進位MB。
KV bytes=2×L×Hkv×D×T×s；2代表K和V，批次數另乘。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 L=24、Hkv=8、D=64、T=2048、s=2 bytes、batch=1。 2×24×8×64×2048×2/2^20=96 MiB；不含分頁中繼資料。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Unicast event traffic=Nrb; multicast and routed replication require separate accounting. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. 10000 teaching neurons, 20 events/s each, 8 bytes/event, initially excluding fanout replication. Traffic=10000×20×8/1e6=1.6 decimal MB/s.

KV bytes=2LHkvDTs; the 2 represents K and V, with batch count additional. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. L24, Hkv8, D64, T2048, s2 bytes, batch1. KV size=96 MiB, excluding paging metadata.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
